I have only a small piece of land for beans, so I will plant with our saved local seed and spread manure from our animals to keep the soil fertile. Chemical fertilizer and pesticides are too costly and hard to find for such a small plot, and since it is just 0.06 hectares, my family and I can weed and harvest it by hand without hiring anyone. We depend entirely on the rainy season, as we have no pump or canal to irrigate.
